# Controlnautas Muse Commerce Demo API
Base: https://data.controlnautas.com
OpenAPI: https://data.controlnautas.com/openapi.yaml

For stock and price questions, use:
1) GET /api/muse/v1/products/search — returns demo products WITH compact live USD price/stock fields
2) GET /api/muse/v1/products/{variantId} — technical facts + embedded live `offer`
3) GET /api/muse/v1/products/{variantId}/offer?quantity=N — full live commercial offer
4) POST /api/muse/v1/preliminary-quotes — immutable preliminary quote + PDF

Auth: Authorization: Bearer <MUSE_API_TOKEN>
Demo only: FICTITIOUS PRODUCT — DEMONSTRATION DATA. Currency: USD.
Do not call /admin.
